title: SubagentStart output
description: Claude Code cannot block here; the Zed extension can refuse the creation or impose a model. Top level open for Claude Code compatibility (same reason as hookSpecificOutput): unknown fields are ignored.

hookSpecificOutput.description: Event-specific output. Open for Claude Code compatibility: Claude Code adds fields here across versions, and a script shared with Claude Code must not be rejected by Zed for a field Zed does not know. Unknown fields are ignored.

hookEventName.description: Claude Code field (sources/claude-code-2026-10-30.md:1064). Must be this event name; in Zed a mismatch is a hook failure.

additionalContext.description: Claude Code field (sources/claude-code-2026-10-30.md:1305). Text added to the model context.

deny_reason.description: If set, the subagent never runs and this text is returned to the parent model as the spawn_agent error. Prototype 0.1: the subagent thread already exists, empty; resuming it runs SubagentStart again.

model.description: Model id imposed on the subagent. Not applied in prototype 0.1: Zed picks the model at creation, before this hook; use PreToolUse on spawn_agent instead.
